title: add VPC control-plane provisioning terraform module: subnets, endpoints, security groups, peering, dns
author: Maya Thompson
description: Add a new Terraform module (modules/vpc-control-plane) and example usage to provision the VPC and networking required for the Redwood Private control plane on AWS. Motivation: make private control plane installs repeatable, auditable, and compatible with Dedicated/Private deployments by providing canonical subnets (public/private/control-plane), managed interface and gateway endpoints (S3, ECR, STS, SSM), reusable security group patterns, optional VPC peering/transit configuration, and Route 53 private hosted zone delegation for control-plane DNS. This PR includes configuration options for CIDR allocation, AZ balancing, NAT/egress choices (NAT GW vs egress-only nat instances), explicit route tables, and zero-trust security group rules scoped to account IDs and IP ranges. Also adds outputs and example variables for cross-account peering (customer VPC <-> control-plane VPC) and a DNS delegation helper to create a private hosted zone and associate it across accounts. Migration/upgrades: includes a migration guide in docs/upgrade-vpc.md describing a no-downtime path for existing on-prem installs via parallel VPC creation + DNS cutover. Linear ENG-742 contains design notes and rollout checklist. This is a feature PR with full test coverage in the terraform plan CI jobs and manual smoke test steps documented in the PR thread.

release_notes: New Terraform module: vpc-control-plane. Provides opinionated VPC layout and helpers for provisioning subnets, endpoints, security groups, optional cross-account peering, and private DNS delegation for the Redwood Private control plane. Includes upgrade guidance and CI plan coverage.
migration_notes: See docs/upgrade-vpc.md for step-by-step migration path. Strategy: create new control-plane VPC in parallel, establish endpoints and peering, associate private hosted zone, perform DNS cutover, then decommission legacy VPC. No expected service downtime if DNS TTLs are staged as documented.
testing_summary: Added terraform plan CI checks for examples and a smoke test that exercises route table and endpoint creation using live AWS test account. Manual verification performed by infra team: VPC subnets, endpoints, security groups, and private hosted zone association validated in staging account.
notes_for_ops: Operators should review default CIDR ranges and AZ distribution for target region; if using existing peering, set enable_cross_account_peering=false and follow manual acceptance steps in docs. Ensure SSM parameter names used by installer are present or updated via migration guide.
